items.headline: Nike's Air Max Goadome Low Foam goes all black
items.caption: A sneaker-boot with the wavy Foamposite upper.
body: Low-top Air Max boot meets hoops DNA.
The stealthy colour makes it easy to wear.
How to wear it: black cargo trousers and a puffer.

items.headline: Nike's Sprint Sister lands in suede 'Flax'
items.caption: Tan suede, creamy leather and frilly laces.
body: Highsnobiety calls it the stylish sibling.
Vintage, velvety and simple.
How to wear it: with cream chinos.

items.headline: Million Goods' store sells clothes, wine and a good time
items.caption: The new Fort Greene flagship has natural wine downstairs and a garden out back.
body: Founders Drew Kaufmann and Matt Reyer built a place to hang out.
A serious sound system too.
Style lesson: shop where you'd want to stay.

items.headline: Nike revives Gyakusou with Undercover's Jun Takahashi
items.caption: Fashion's most experimental running line is back after five years.
body: Gyakusou means 'running in reverse'.
Nike also recently brought back its Nike Mind line.
How to wear it: running gear as streetwear.

items.headline: Converse Chuck 70s go Gore-Tex for winter
items.caption: Suede uppers that can handle wet pavements.
body: The waterproof label sits on the heel.
Converse joins Nike and New Balance in winterising classics.
How to wear it: with dark denim and a parka.

items.headline: New Balance's 992 'Black Turtledove' looks unfinished on purpose
items.caption: Exposed leather edges for the shoe's 20th anniversary.
body: The midsole looks pre-yellowed.
It shows what's normally hidden.
How to wear it: with wide black trousers.

items.headline: Timberland's 6-Inch boot gets fancy
items.caption: Woven leather and waterproof suede versions of the 1976 classic.
body: Built for New England workers, adopted by hip-hop.
Now made for good jeans.
How to wear it: with selvedge denim.

items.headline: Timothée Chalamet starts puffer season
items.caption: Winter outerwear courtside at MSG on a 68°F day.
body: His bench includes North Face, Supreme and Thug Club puffers.
Plus Visvim, Red Wing and Timberland boots.
Style lesson: big puffer, sturdy boots.

items.headline: Shohei Ohtani signs a career-long New Balance deal
items.caption: The Dodgers star commits to the brand until he retires.
body: He's a four-time MVP with two World Series rings.
The deal runs to the end of his playing career.
Style lesson: loyalty to what fits.

items.headline: A pink-gold Reverso fit for Pattinson's Bond
items.caption: Jaeger-LeCoultre unveils it a week after he was named 007.
body: He's a JLC ambassador.
'I definitely like really thin watches,' he says.
Style lesson: thin watch, sharp cuff.

items.headline: The watches of GTA 6 and their real-life twins
items.caption: From Rolex Day-Dates to Casio digitals in Vice City.
body: Esquire matches the game's watches to real ones.
A guide for gamers who like watches.
Style lesson: a Casio is always cool.

items.headline: A refuge for 200,000 walruses is protected forever
items.caption: Barrier islands off Point Lay, Alaska, are now in a 47,000-acre protected area.
body: They hold North America's largest Pacific walrus gatherings.
The Interior Alaska Land Trust holds the land.

items.headline: Volunteer finds a lost toddler in the Arizona desert
items.caption: Two-year-old Vella Campillo wandered off near Eloy at sundown.
body: Grandfather Jay Stewart found her in the cold night.
'She may not be our child, but she could be,' he said.

items.headline: He waits at the prison gates so no one walks out alone
items.caption: Freddie Nole and his wife Sue meet people leaving prison.
body: A short film rides along with him for a day.
'Believe me, it never gets old,' he says.
